title: TonalEnergy Tuning Log Status Mix
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tonalenergy:tuning
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(tuning_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the TonalEnergy tuning log feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `tuning_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges the overall mood of your TonalEnergy tuning log feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
